title: Tax
description: Practice taxes and documents: carnê-leão, Receita Saúde, receipts, service invoices and filing calendar.

agenda.title: Tax calendar

description.pf: Individual professional: carnê-leão (DARF 0190), Receita Saúde receipts and INSS (GPS).
description.simples: Simples Nacional: monthly DAS and annual DMED. Check factor R to know the annex.
description.presumido: Presumed profit: annual DMED. Other taxes are handled by your accountant.

items.receitaSaude: Receita Saúde receipts for the month

agenda.none: Nothing due in the coming weeks.
agenda.disclaimer: Amounts and dates are estimates from what is recorded in Salutti; the official filing is done in Carnê-Leão Web and by your accountant.
agenda.clinicWarning: {count, plural, other {This practice has # active professionals.}} Carnê-leão is individual: the calculation and the file use the tax profile holder’s CPF with every payment. Each professional should report only their own sessions.

profile.title: Tax profile
profile.description: Sets the obligations, the receipt and the file for the Revenue Service.
profile.cpfHint: Printed on receipts and used in the Receita Saúde file.
profile.occupationHint: Occupation code in Carnê-Leão Web (psychologist: 255). Each dependent deducts R$ 189.59 per month.

errors.onlyFinance: Only whoever manages finances (owner, admin or finance) can change the tax profile.

receitaSaude.notice: {count, plural, =0 {Receita Saúde: no receipts to send.} one {Receita Saúde: # receipt to send.} other {Receita Saúde: # receipts to send.}} There is no direct integration: download the month's CSV and import it in Carnê-Leão Web (Escrituração > Importar). Rows flagged S generate the receipts.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.description: Created on each payment. Print to give to the patient.
receipts.printOf: Print receipt {number} (opens in a new tab)

nfse.title: Service invoices (NFS-e)
nfse.sandbox: Test issuance: the national issuer integration (with an e-CNPJ certificate) is not active yet.

carneLeao.title: Carnê-leão · {month}
carneLeao.description: Income received from individuals in the month, with the deductions recorded in Salutti. Check it in Carnê-Leão Web.
carneLeao.usingSimplified: The simplified discount was higher than INSS, dependents and alimony, so it was used. The cash book is deducted separately.
carneLeao.usingLegal: INSS, dependents and alimony added up to more than the simplified discount, so they were used. The cash book is deducted separately.
carneLeao.income: Income ({count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}})
carneLeao.darfDescription: Generate the payment slip in Carnê-Leão Web after importing the income.
carneLeao.darfDue: Due on {date} (last business day of the following month).
carneLeao.under10: Below R$ 10.00 nothing is paid this month: it adds to the following months.
carneLeao.exportDescription: CSV in Carnê-Leão Web format (Escrituração > Importar). Under the individual regime it also generates Receita Saúde receipts.
carneLeao.needsCpf: Enter a valid holder CPF in the tax profile.
carneLeao.missingCpf: {count, plural, one {# payment without a valid payer CPF: left out of the file.} other {# payments without a valid payer CPF: left out of the file.}}
carneLeao.disclaimer: Estimate for checking. The official amount is the one in Carnê-Leão Web. Only payments from individuals recorded in Salutti count here: income from companies or insurers (with tax withheld at source) and reimbursements are left out.
carneLeao.needsOccupation: Enter the Carnê-Leão Web occupation code in the tax profile.
carneLeao.blockRegime: Carnê-leão and the Receita file only apply to the individual (PF) regime.
carneLeao.onlyFinance: Only people who manage finances can download the file.
carneLeao.exportOnlyPending: The file includes payments not yet exported, so receipts are not duplicated in Receita Saúde.
carneLeao.exportNoReceitaSaude: Aesthetic procedures do not generate Receita Saúde receipts: the file only records the income.
carneLeao.markImported: {count, plural, one {I imported it: mark # receipt as exported} other {I imported it: mark # receipts as exported}}
carneLeao.markImportedHint: Use after importing the file into Carnê-Leão Web.
carneLeao.imported: {count, plural, =0 {No pending receipt with the payer's CPF.} one {# receipt marked as exported.} other {# receipts marked as exported.}}

factorR.title: Factor R
factorR.noRevenue: No revenue recorded in the last 12 months.
factorR.isIII: With factor R of 28% or more, health services go to Annex III (from 6%).
factorR.isV: Below 28%: Annex V (from 15.5%). {missing} more payroll over 12 months would reach 28%.
factorR.how: Payroll comes from bills in the "Personnel" group (salaries, owner's pay and charges); revenue, from paid charges. Confirm with your accountant.

receiptPrint.title: Receipt
receiptPrint.needsDoc: Enter the CPF (tax profile) or the practice's CNPJ: the Revenue Service requires the receiver's document.
receiptPrint.body: I received from {name} the amount of {amount} ({words}), for {service} provided to {patient} on {date}.

yearReport.title: Payment statement
yearReport.note: Amounts actually paid in the year, for the income tax return (health expenses). Keep it with the receipts.
yearReport.noteEstetica: Amounts actually paid during the year. Aesthetic procedures are not deductible medical expenses for income tax.
